subject: Discovery recap + proposed pilot scope and onboarding ops
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@novahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-28T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Recap: Discovery + Proposed Pilot Scope (next steps)

Hi Alicia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before a formal kickoff: 

Pain points you described
- Inconsistent summarization and triage across incoming support tickets; manual triage is ~3x slower than target.
- Performance and cost concerns: need sub-300ms P95 for summary endpoint and predictable per-ticket cost.
- Data residency: initial data will be US-only but procurement asked about EU readiness down the road.

Proposed pilot (high-level)
- Duration: 4 weeks (sandbox) + 2-week validation window.
- Scope: route 5k anonymized tickets through Redwood API -> LLM summarization + simple classification (priority/route).
- Success metrics: 1) P95 inference latency < 300ms, 2) Summaries judged >=85% helpful by your QA team, 3) Cost target <= $0.005 per ticket after batching and cache.
- Deliverables: prompt seed + eval harness, baseline perf report, 2-week checkpoint readout, mutual action plan.

Owners & timeline
- Nova Health: Alicia Park (PM), procurement contact (procurement@novahealth.com) — you to provide dataset slice and access owners by 2027-01-03.
- Redwood: Logan Wright (AM, pilot owner) + Kimberly Park (Ops/infra), Sean Gallagher (CS lead).
- Proposed kickoff: 2027-01-04 or 2027-01-05 — please confirm preferred date/time.

Access & setup items we need before kickoff
- SSO/SAML metadata or a service account for initial API access.
- Anonymized sample dataset (≤5k rows) + schema.
- Procurement: PO or standard SOW route — we can start with a short SOW draft.

Attachments: pilot_scope.csv (scope & metrics table), prompt_seed_v1.jsonl (initial prompt examples), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (living checklist).

Ask: please confirm (1) pilot dates/availability for kickoff, (2) who will own dataset upload and SSO, and (3) whether procurement prefers a short SOW or purchase order.

Thanks — I’ll hold 2027-01-04/05 windows for a 60–90 minute kickoff until you confirm.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@novahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-28T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + Proposed Pilot Scope (next steps)

Hi Logan — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few things from our side: 

We’re aligned on the pilot scope and the main success metrics you listed. A few notes and asks: 
- Dataset: I’ll share a 5k anonymized CSV by 2027-01-03. Our data team will scrub PHI and provide a column mapping.
- Kickoff: 2027-01-05 at 10:00 PT works best for Alicia + our eng lead (Marcus Lee).
- Procurement: We need a short SOW to start; procurement will require our legal redlines and a SOC 2 report. Can you attach/redline the SOW?
- Data residency: US-only for now — we may want EU-ready language in the SOW but not required for the initial pilot.

Also looping in procurement: procurement@novahealth.com for PO/SOW coordination.

Alicia
Alicia Park
Product Manager, Nova Health
alicia.park@novahealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2290

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Alicia Park <alicia.park@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-29T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + Proposed Pilot Scope (next steps)

Thanks — quick ops notes from Infra/Access perspective so procurement and engineering have clear asks before kickoff: 

1) Access patterns
- For the pilot we recommend a short-lived API key + IP allowlist for the sandbox. For longer runs we can onboard SSO/SAML and a service account.
- If Nova prefers SSO, please send SAML metadata or idp-init URL. We can support Okta, Azure AD.

2) Data upload
- Upload to our secure ingest bucket (we will provide a pre-signed URL). Please provide a sample CSV and schema.

3) Security & compliance
- Attachments: SSO_setup_guide.pdf (step-by-step), and I’ll attach our SOC2-summary.pdf in the second pass if legal asks for it.

4) Technical runbook checkpoints
- Week 0: access + baseline test with 100 tickets.
- Week 2: perf checkpoint + prompt tuning.
- Week 4: validation report + go/no-go decision.

I’ve added a short SAML checklist and the SSO guide as an attachment. Sean — can you own the evaluation harness and the prompt-eval rubric?

Kimberly Park
Head, Infra & Integrations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachment: SSO_setup_guide.pdf (SAML metadata examples and sample ACS URL)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@novahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-29T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + Proposed Pilot Scope (next steps)

Perfect — thank you both. Final confirmations and next items before kickoff (I’ll convert to the MAP and share the calendar invite):

- Kickoff: 2027-01-05 10:00 PT — 60 minutes (invite incoming).
- Deliverables I will share today: short SOW draft (SOW_draft.pdf), living mutual action plan (link above), pilot_task_list.csv.
- Compliance: Kimberly will attach SOC 2 summary and security contact; Alicia — if procurement wants a structured PoV contract, I can loop legal but we can start with the short SOW.
- Access: Alicia to share SAML metadata or confirm preference for API key by 2027-01-03.
- Evaluation: Sean to produce prompt-eval rubric and baseline test script (will post to the MAP).

Attachments in this thread: SOW_draft.pdf (starter SOW), pilot_task_list.csv (owner/timeline checklist).

Onward — I’ll post the kickoff invite and the DocuSign SOW link once Alicia confirms procurement preference.

Thanks — looking forward to starting.

— Logan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
